question: hay algún comercio al que no le hayamos liquidado nunca
sql:
SELECT m.merchant_id, m.trade_name, m.country_code, m.risk_tier, d.group_sk, d.group_name
FROM dim_merchant AS m
LEFT JOIN dim_corporate_group AS d ON m.group_sk = d.group_sk AND d.is_ultimate_parent = 1
WHERE m.is_active = 1
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fact_settlement_batch f WHERE f.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
)
ORDER BY m.country_code, m.trade_name
